insight: Both Colossians 3:23 and 3:17 emphasize the comprehensive nature of Christian conduct, urging believers to dedicate all their actions and words to the Lord. Verse 3:23 calls for wholehearted work "as to the Lord, and not unto men," highlighting the motivation behind labor as service to Christ rather than human authorities. Similarly, 3:17 expands this principle to all activities, "in word or deed," done "in the name of the Lord Jesus," underscoring representation of Christ's authority and continual thanksgiving. Together, they present a unified call to live every aspect of life under Christ's lordship and for His glory.
